primary_test.definition: pre-generation, overall official success, preregistered layer, trajectory-level mean over selected tool decisions
primary_test.evidence_rule: A domain passes only if held-out AUROC > 0.5 and the one-sided label-permutation p-value is < 0.05. Both domains passing is the preregistered consistency criterion.

metric_notes.auroc: 0.5 is random; computed on held-out official test tasks
metric_notes.balanced_accuracy_at_centroid_midpoint: no threshold tuning; zero is the midpoint of train centroids
